name: Meta-labeling the 15M + 5M alignment signal
question: Can a model trained on 2008-2018 choose a subset of 15M + 5M alignment signals that has positive expectancy after costs in 2023-2026, and does better than taking every signal and better than the app's own 4H/1H multi-timeframe rule?
symbols: All 28 pairs in data/historical_5m except EURZAR (its 5M archive has about 10k bars)
source: Local data/historical_5m, _15m, _1h, _4h CSV archives (UTC bar-open timestamps); no network data. High/Low are widened in memory to contain Open/Close; the number of repaired bars is reported. Non-positive or non-finite prices stop the run.
scores: The app's score_series_for_backtest on each timeframe. A bar's score is usable only after that bar closes (open time + bar length).

primary_signal.state: At each 5M bar close: +1 if the last closed 15M score >= 25 and this 5M score >= 25; -1 if both <= -25; otherwise 0
primary_signal.signal: The state becomes nonzero or changes sign versus the previous 5M bar
primary_signal.entry: Open of the next 5M bar, only if it starts exactly 5 minutes later
primary_signal.positions: One per pair; signals while a position is open are ignored

trade.stop: 1.5 x ATR14 of the last closed 15M bar
trade.max_holding: 4 hours of clock time (at most 48 5M bars); timeout exits at the close of the last bar in the window
trade.path: Stop first if both levels are inside one bar; adverse gap fills at the bar open

label: 1 if net R at 1.5 pip round-trip cost is > 0, else 0
features: stop distance in pips and cost fraction (1.5 pip / stop pips)
15M ATR14 over its median of the previous 1920 15M bars (about 20 trading days)
5M realized volatility of the last 48 bars over that of the last 5760 bars
15M RSI14 and Bollinger band position, side-signed around their midpoints
side-signed distance of the 1H close from 1H EMA200, in 1H ATR14
UTC hour of day (sin, cos) and weekday
USD pair within 60 minutes before or after a scheduled NFP/FOMC release (research_news_scan.build_events kept events)

splits.purge: A trade belongs to a split only if both its entry and exit fall inside it

selection_on_validation: Fit each model on train. For coverage levels 10%, 20%, 30% and 50%, the probability threshold is the validation quantile that keeps that share of validation signals. Choose the (model, coverage) with the highest validation mean net R at 1.5 pips, among choices keeping at least 1000 validation trades. Freeze the model trained on 2008-2018 and the probability threshold value; neither is refit or changed afterwards.

comparisons_on_final.app_mtf_rule: Signals where side-signed 4H and 1H scores are >= 25 and the side-signed 5M score is >= 60 (forex_decision_core.decide_mtf_signal for a 5M entry at the default threshold 60, without the structure/RSI/MACD/Bollinger gates)

statistics: Unit: UTC calendar day, averaging net R over the kept trades that day across pairs. forex_decision_core.stationary_bootstrap_mean_test, 2000 simulations, mean block length 5, seed 42.
success_criteria: Kept final trades mean net R at 1.5 pips > 0 with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
Kept mean net R at 1.5 pips above all_signals
Kept mean net R at 1.5 pips above app_mtf_rule
Kept mean net R at 3 pips > 0
use: Only if all criteria hold may the model's probability be shown on scan cards, as information that never changes a decision, ranking or gate.
parameter_search: None beyond the validation choice above; nothing is changed after the final evaluation
